key_takeaways: A Bali villa wedding package may bundle use of the villa for a set time, its staff, a set number of bedrooms and nights, and a planner's core set-up; what it covers varies by villa, so read it line by line.
Ask first whether the package is exclusive use or event use: which spaces, for which hours, and who else is on the property.
The items to check in a villa package are practical: power and generator, guest toilets, beds for the guests the villa cannot sleep, wet-weather cover, access for coaches and trucks, and neighbours.
Ask for four capacity numbers, not one: standing, seated, sleeping and parking or drop-off.

Wedded Wonderland does not list private villas in Bali; the closest option we can show is taking over a whole resort, such as the Resort Exclusivity package on our Nirjhara Bali Waterfall Weddings listing.

faq.q: Can you get married at a private villa in Bali?
faq.a: You can hold your ceremony at a villa. Whether a villa ceremony is also your legal marriage depends on your route. If you marry legally in Indonesia, the Attorney-General's Department says an overseas marriage is generally recognised in Australia if it was valid where it took place and would have been valid here. Read what to do with a marriage certificate issued overseas.

faq.q: What is a banjar fee for a Bali villa wedding?
faq.a: Our Bali cost guide lists banjar (local community) fees among the hidden costs of a Bali wedding, next to generator hire and corkage. We cannot give you a figure. Ask the villa manager whether one applies to your event, who arranges it and whether it sits inside the quote, and get the answer in writing.

faq.q: How much does a Bali villa wedding cost?
faq.a: It depends on guest numbers, nights, events and how much the villa leaves for you to hire in, so we do not quote a villa price here. Our guide to Bali wedding budgets gives figures in USD and notes that suppliers usually take a 30 to 50% deposit, with the balance due 30 to 60 days before.

faq.q: Can all our guests stay at the wedding villa?
faq.a: Only if its beds match your guest list, so ask for the number of beds rather than bedrooms. For a larger group, plan nearby villas or a hotel room block. On our own packages page, guest accommodation is listed as "Paid separately, usually at negotiated group rates", so budget for it as its own line.

faq.q: How early should we secure a Bali villa for an exclusive-use week?
faq.a: Our Bali cost guide says premium venues book out 12 to 18 months ahead. For a villa, secure the exclusive-use dates and nearby guest rooms together. Marrying legally in Australia first? Your Notice of Intended Marriage must reach your celebrant at least one month and no more than 18 months before, says the Attorney-General's Department.
